create_agent_move_to_beacon: create a scripted agent that selects the army and moves to the nearest beacon on the MoveToBeacon map
create_agent_collect_mineral_shards: create a scripted agent that selects the army and moves to the closest mineral shard from the marine group center
create_agent_collect_mineral_shards_feat: create a scripted agent that controls two marines independently using feature units to collect mineral shards alternately
create_agent_collect_mineral_shards_raw: create a scripted agent that controls two marines independently using raw units and raw actions to collect mineral shards alternately
create_agent_defeat_roaches: create a scripted agent that selects the army and attacks the enemy roach with the maximum y coordinate
